I`d like to describe our experience in this condominium, and show all advantages and disadvantages from our side 🧐 Hope it will be helpful for somebody 🙂
📍LOCATION: central part of Phuket. Close to the biggest mall in Phuket (few km) and big supermarkets (even by foot). But far from the beaches.
👨‍💼 PROPERTY CONSULTANT: good communication skills and English. He guided us very professionally in the very beginning and through our further staying.
🏡APARTMENTS: small, but pretty nice and cosy. We rented 1-bedroom flat, it`s 34 square meters, but to be honest, it feels less. Good enough for a couple. But maybe too small for family with kids and if you have a lot of stuff, so it would be better to rent 2-bedroom apartment.
🍽 KITCHENETTE equipped with basic culinary utensils and appliances, microwave, fridge, small electric stove, toaster (useless for us). We were in great necessity of any elementery coffee maker here instead of toaster.
🛋 LIVING ROOM and hallway in one. Here is a sofa (could be used as full bed), air condition, TV.
🛏 BEDROOM: good hard mattress, wardrobe, linens (2 sets), 4 towels and 6 pillows, TV, air condition.
🚿 BATHROOM: a shower with electric water heater, good ventilation in it.
⛱ BALCONY: with washing machine (it`s a great advantage!), hanger and some place for smoking or drinking coffee.
🏔We had mountain VIEW called «Monkeys hill» 🐒 (by the way, nice place to visit 😉). So it was quite in the morning and noon, but sometimes it was loud live music on the night market nearby till night.
🚗 🛵Guarded bikes and cars PARKING only for condo residents (you need to put special sticker on your bike or car to avoid a fine). Sometimes it`s not enough places for cars.
👨‍✈️ CCTV, access to condo only for residents, no strangers. Security guards and other staff are friendly.
💎2 elegant LOBBIES has enough space for relax or work, but air conditioning could be switched off and it becomes hot.
🌴Nice GREEN ZONES with lawn, trees and palms. Сleanliness maintained everywhere. Comfortable shared spaces outdoor and smoking area.
🏊‍♀️ SWIMMING POOL is clean, around 20-ish meters long. There is also small pool for kids. Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Depends on the time of a day it could be crowdy or nobody there. But annoying insects are 24/7 here 😁
🏋️‍♀️ GYM is too small, but better than nothing. 7 trainers for cardio, 2 benches and dumbbells (pairs from 2,5 kg till 25 kg). No barbell 🙁, so if you are training with free weights, you will have to exercise your imagination with only dumbbells 😃 Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Enough place for stretching or yoga nearby gym🧘‍♀️

To sum up briefly, nice place and good value for money. Recommended if you are going to stay for 1 month and more. To avoid any conflicts just follow the rules of using sharing areas, be polite and enjoy! 😊
Very well maintained with a regularly cleaned pool and small gym. Weights, running and step machines available. Reception areas are comfortable and air-conditioned. Great for long or short stay.

Great place! Very cozy and nice. We’ve been living there for 6 months! Good location for living if you want to get into any location in Phuket soon! Good quality of materials, always clean pool and garden.

I spent one month at this place, I enjoyed my stay  and was overall happy but there is something important to note: I had an apartment facing a quiet area and the city, not other apartments of the building or the busy main-road just next to the building so I was lucky (I had privacy and quiet time) because otherwise my experience would not have been so good.
- there is a nice pool and also a gym which I used a lot;
- the surrounding area is not great, there is not much around (perhaps with the exception of the Chilva market
- the beaches and attractions are quite far away so you must be prepared for longer rides! The area is not very "walk-friendly".

The apartments are small but adequate. It’s close to amenities but not close enough that it’s convenient. The closest 7/11 is a 15 minute walk, which is fine except for the Phuket heat. Tesco is kinda close but also far enough to be a pain (on the road you need to drive quite a distance to navigate the highway on the way back). The place is nice enough for a short stay but it’s in a dead part of town, with nothing in comfortable walking distance, so don’t really expect to be going anywhere without getting on your scooter on in a taxi. Having a mini-mart or bar/restaurant on-site would be a game changer.

Love this place, i lived here for 1.5 years. It's a very high standard. Security is excellent, pool is amazing, and so is the gym. It has a peaceful and luxurious atmosphere. With the addition of the new secure car park area there is plenty of parking for both cars amd motobikes.

A great place to live if you want frequent headaches from 100+ internet routers in everyone's room pulsing Wi-Fi  into your brain 24/7.

Unfortunately, this a problem everywhere in Phuket and Thailand because they don't have any wired internet (ethernet/broadband). They only have wireless which is why there's overlapping spheres of Electro Magnetic Frequency EMF everywhere.

Who wants to live inside of the equivalent of a microwave??

Very beautiful on the outside, NASTY inside. When we entered the apartment, first reaction "wow!", next......dust all over, stains, dirty sheets, yellow and brownish spots on all towels, disgustingly dirty floors, red stains all over doors/shower, somebody's pubic hair in bathroom area and bed, I can continue endlessly. We had to go to supermarket and buy own cleaning stuff to feel at comfort. Yes, the whole territory looks beautiful, and the apartment looks shining and thoughtful on the picture, but in our case, FavStay clearly did not care about tourists as humans who would like to get a proper service for the money they pay. Not washing towels and sheets? I can survive dirty floors/glasses/dust...but a simple basic hygiene should be an obvious point!

It was a great stay, the apartment was great. Big enough for two people. The apartment was kept well. Phuket now offer Grab Bike(Motorcycle), This option is much cheaper than local motorcycle and the driver is much more friendly. Love the swimming pool as well.

The location is OK, but expect that you will need a car to get around every single day, unless you prefer to just hang out by the pool (it is a nice pool!) Just local cable on TV. Comfy furniture. Responsive management. Probably my biggest …

Staying here in an AirBnB. Nice pool, small gym that has treadmills, crosstrainers, bikes and free weights. The guards are helpful when the Grab taxi gets lost on the way. There is not much space in the kitchen (or anywhere in the apartment) but a one bedroom is okay for a couple with few possessions or only staying for a few weeks. The condo has strict rules about not hanging laundry over the balcony rail, which can be tricky if you don't have a proper clothes horse. There is not a lot of useful places very close by, other than the Tesco Lotus (which has a Starbucks, food court and other vendors) and Chain of Love Cafe. If you stay here, you will need either your own transport or the willingness to spend on Taxis. Phuket is not a pedestrian friendly place if you're going more than a block.

I had a 12 month tenancy at The Base, a lovely place however the management were shocking! The number of issues we had here were unbelievable. The only staff that were of any help were the Cleaners, they were lovely! Management fined us, when parking was included in our tenancy, THB2000 at midnight after returning from a night out at the front of the condo, not even inside the security barrier. No signs, no explanations just deducted from deposit. Our Friend lost a door pass, they made us report the loss at the police station, get a crime report and then fined us THB500 for a new one. We returned our keys at the end of the tenancy, forgot to get a receipt from the main office for them (!) after which they denied all knowledge of receipt! Another fine! Until I challenged them to check their CCTV at which point miraculously they found them!!! The management are crafty, instigate unreasonable non user friendly rules and their word is final, beware living here, you will get burnt!
